description: The UI window only needs the core IPC (and its event listener, for the hotkey events); every plugin (tray, notifications, dialogs, deep links, opener, global shortcut) is driven from Rust, so no plugin command is exposed to the webview but one: the notification permission read in notification.json, which tauri-plugin-notification's page script makes at every page load on Linux and macOS. The shell's own hotkey commands are granted in hotkey.json.
